macros.name: AlCapFnt
macros.doc: \AlCapSty and \AlCapFnt are used to define style and font shape of “Algorithm #:” in caption.

macros.name: AlCapNameFnt
macros.doc: \AlCapNameFnt{<text>} sets <text> in caption name typography, that is the same used, together with \AlCapNameSty to print the name of caption you set by calling \caption{name}.

macros.name: AlCapNameSty
macros.doc: \AlCapNameSty{<text>} sets <text> in caption name typography, that is the same used, together with \AlCapNameFnt to print the name of caption you set by calling \caption{name}.

macros.name: AlCapSkip
macros.doc: \AlCapSkip is the dimension of the distance between algorithm body and caption in plain and boxed mode.

macros.name: AlCapSty
macros.doc: \AlCapSty and \AlCapFnt are used to define style and font shape of “Algorithm #:” in caption.

macros.name: algomargin
macros.doc: \algomargin this is the value of the margin of all algorithms.

macros.name: AlTitleFnt
macros.doc: \AlTitleFnt{<text>} is used to typeset “Algorithm #:” in title, together with \AlTitleSty.

macros.name: ArgSty
macros.doc: \ArgSty{<text>} sets <text> in argument type style.

macros.name: Begin
macros.doc: \SetKwBlock{Begin}{begin}{end} defines a macro \Begin{txt} which denotes a block.

macros.name: CommentSty
macros.doc: \CommentSty{<text>} sets <text> in comment typography.

macros.name: DataSty
macros.doc: \DataSty{<text>} sets <text> in data typography.

macros.name: DecMargin
macros.doc: \DecMargin{length} decreases the size of the \algomargin by the length given in argument.

macros.name: DontPrintSemicolon
macros.doc: \DontPrintSemicolon the ‘;’ are no more printed at the end of each line.

macros.name: Else
macros.doc: Else’s text is writen in a block and terminating by the endif.

macros.name: FuncArgSty
macros.doc: \FuncArgSty{<text>} sets <text> in function argument type style.

macros.name: FuncSty
macros.doc: \FuncSty{<text>} sets <text> in function type style.

macros.name: IncMargin
macros.doc: \IncMargin{length} increases the size of the \algomargin by the length given in argument.

macros.name: Indm
macros.doc: \Indm indents minus → the text is shifted to the left.

macros.name: Indp
macros.doc: \Indp indents plus → the text is shifted to the right.

macros.name: KwSty
macros.doc: \KwSty{<text>} sets <text> in keyword type style.

macros.name: lElse
macros.doc: Else’s text is written on the same line as else.

macros.name: lElseIf
macros.doc: ElseIf’s text is written on the same line as else if.

macros.name: LinesNotNumbered
macros.doc: \LinesNotNumbered makes lines of the following algorithms no be auto-numbered.

macros.name: LinesNumberedHidden
macros.doc: \LinesNumberedHidden makes lines of the following algorithms be auto-numbered, but numbers stay hidden.

macros.name: listofalgorithms
macros.doc: \listofalgorithms inserts the list of all algorithms having a caption.

macros.name: lnl
macros.doc: \lnl{label} numbers and labels the line : must begin the line.

macros.name: nl
macros.doc: \nl numbers the line: must begin the line.

macros.name: nllabel
macros.doc: \nllabel{label} macro for labelling lines when auto-numbering is active.

macros.name: nlset
macros.doc: \nlset{text} works as \nl except that the additional argument is the text to put at the beginning of the line.

macros.name: NlSty
macros.doc: \NlSty{<text>} sets <text> in number line typography.

macros.name: NoCaptionOfAlgo
macros.doc: \NoCaptionOfAlgo doesn’t print Algorithm and its number in the caption.

macros.name: ProcArgFnt
macros.doc: \ProcArgFnt{<text>} sets <text> in font shape of argument of procedure/environment caption, that is the same used, together with \ProcArgSty, to print int i if \caption{int i} was called.

macros.name: ProcArgSty
macros.doc: \ProcArgSty{<text>} sets <text> in argument of procedure/function typography, that is the same used, together with \ProcArgFnt, to print int i if \caption{Proc(int i)} was called.

macros.name: ProcNameFnt
macros.doc: \ProcNameFnt{<text>} sets <text> in procedure/function name typography, that is the same used, together with \ProcNameSty to print the name of caption you set by calling \caption{Proc(int i)}.

macros.name: ProcSty
macros.doc: \ProcSty and \ProcFnt are used to define style and font shape of “Procedure” in caption of procedure and function environment.

macros.name: ProgSty
macros.doc: \ProgSty{<text>} sets <text> in programm (KwProg) type style.

macros.name: ResetInOut
macros.doc: \ResetInOut{input} resets the position of the ‘:’ for all macros defined previously by \SetKwInOut{Kw}{input}.

macros.name: RestoreCaptionOfAlgo
macros.doc: \RestoreCaptionOfAlgo restores correct captions that was corrupted by a \NoCaptionOfAlgo macro.

macros.name: RestyleAlgo
macros.doc: \RestyleAlgo{style} sets the style of the following algorithms to that given by this macro (plain, boxed, ruled, algoruled) unlike those indicated in the options of the package (see options of the package).

macros.name: SetAlCapFnt
macros.doc: \SetAlCapFnt{<font>} sets the font used for {algorithm: } in caption of algorithm (default is set to \relax).

macros.name: SetAlCapHSkip
macros.doc: \SetAlCapHSkip{length} sets the horizontal skip before Algorithm: in caption when used in ruled algorithm.

macros.name: SetAlCapNameFnt
macros.doc: \SetAlCapNameFnt{<font>} sets the font used by caption text.

macros.name: SetAlCapNameSty
macros.doc: \SetAlCapNameSty{<commandname>}: sets the command that will be used by \AlCapNameSty to define style of caption text.

macros.name: SetAlCapSkip
macros.doc: \SetAlCapSkip{length} sets the lenght of \AlCapSkip) dimension between algorithm body and caption.

macros.name: SetAlCapSty
macros.doc: \SetAlCapSty{<commandname>}: sets the command that will be used by \AlCapSty to define style of Algorithm #: in caption.

macros.name: SetAlgoBlockMarkers
macros.doc: \SetAlgoBlockMarkers{begin keyword}{end keyword} defines begin and end keywords that will be used by \DisplayBlockMarkers.

macros.name: SetAlgoCaptionLayout
macros.doc: \SetAlgoCaptionLayout{style} sets global style of the caption; style must be the name of a macro taking one argument (the text of the caption).

macros.name: SetAlgoFuncName
macros.doc: \SetAlgoFuncName{aname}{anautorefname} sets the name of Function printed by procedure environment (the environment prints Function by default).

macros.name: SetAlgoInsideSkip
macros.doc: To put an extra space, use \SetAlgoInsideSkip{skip command}, for example \SetAlgoInsideSkip{smallskip}, like for \SetAlgoSkip{skip command}.

macros.name: SetAlgoLined
macros.doc: \SetAlgoLined prints vertical lines between bloc start-end keywords as begin, end.

macros.name: SetAlgoNlRelativeSize
macros.doc: \SetAlgoNlRelativeSize{number} sets the relative size of line number (see section 9.3) for more details on this command.

macros.name: SetAlgoRefName
macros.doc: \SetAlgoRefName{ref} which changes the default ref (number of the algorithm) by the name given in parameter.

macros.name: SetAlgoRefRelativeSize
macros.doc: \SetAlgoRefRelativeSize{relative integer} which sets the output size of reference in list of algorithms for references set by \SetAlgoRefName.

macros.name: SetAlgoVlined
macros.doc: \SetAlgoVlined prints a vertical line followed by a little horizontal line between the start and the end of each block.

macros.name: SetAlTitleFnt
macros.doc: \SetAlTitleFnt{<font>} sets the font used in \TitleOfAlgo command (default is set to \relax, so text is kept as it is).

macros.name: SetAlTitleSty
macros.doc: \SetAlTitleSty{<commandname>} sets the command that will be used by \AlTitleSty to define style of algorithm title given by \TitleOfAlgo (default is set to \SetAlTitleSty{textbf}).

macros.name: SetArgSty
macros.doc: \SetArgSty{<font>} sets the argument typography (by default: emph).

macros.name: SetBlockMarkersSty
macros.doc: \SetBlockMarkersSty{<font>} sets block markers typography (by default the same as \KwSty{)}.

macros.name: SetCommentSty
macros.doc: \SetCommentSty{<font>} sets the comment text typography (by default: texttt).

macros.name: SetCustomAlgoRuledWidth
macros.doc: \SetCustomAlgoRuledWidth{length} set a custom ruled width of ruled and algoruled options ; note that by the moment you use this macro, rules will have this fixed length: this can cause strange behavior in multicolumn mode or other layout that change the line width.

macros.name: SetDataSty
macros.doc: \SetDataSty{<font>} sets the data typography (by default: textsf ).

macros.name: SetFillComment
macros.doc: \SetFillComment end mark of comment is flushed to the right so comments fill all the width of text, equivalent to fillcomment option.

macros.name: SetFuncArgSty
macros.doc: \SetFuncArgSty{<font>} sets the typography of function argument (by default: emph).

macros.name: SetFuncSty
macros.doc: \SetFuncSty{<font>} sets the function typography (by default: texttt).

macros.name: SetInd
macros.doc: \SetInd{before rule space}{after rule space} sets the size of the space before the vertical rule and after.

macros.name: SetKw
macros.doc: \SetKw{Kw}{thetext} defines the macro \Kw which defines a keyword thetext and prints it in keyword typography.

macros.name: SetKwArray
macros.doc: \SetKwArray{Kw}{array} which defines an array keywords Kw called array and printed in DataSty style when call with \Kw.

macros.name: SetKwBlock
macros.doc: \SetKwBlock{Begin}{begin}{end} defines a macro \Begin{txt} which denotes a block.

macros.name: SetKwComment
macros.doc: \SetKwComment{Comment}{start}{end} defines a macro \Comment{text comment} which writes text comment between start and end.

macros.name: SetKwFor
macros.doc: \SetKwFor{For}{for}{do}{endfor} defines a loop environment with stop-test done at the beginning of the loop.

macros.name: SetKwFunction
macros.doc: \SetKwFunction{KwFn}{Fn} defines a macro \KwFn{arg} which prints Fn in FuncSty typography and its argument arg in FuncArgSty typography, surrounded by a pair of parentheses.

macros.name: SetKwHangingKw
macros.doc: \SetKwHangingKw{Kw}{thetext} defines a hanging keyword that should act like a combination of \SetKwInput and \SetKw.

macros.name: SetKwInput
macros.doc: \SetKwInput{Kw}{input} defines the macro \Kw{arg} which prints input followed by ‘:’ in key word typography, and behind the argument arg.

macros.name: SetKwSty
macros.doc: \SetKwSty{<font>} sets the Kw typography to <font> (by default: textbf ).

macros.name: SetNlSkip
macros.doc: \SetNlSkip{length} sets the value of the space between the line numbers and the text, by default 1em.

macros.name: SetNoFillComment
macros.doc: \SetNoFillComment end mark of comment is put right after the comment, equivalent to nofillcomment option.

macros.name: SetProcArgSty
macros.doc: \SetProcArgSty{<font>} sets argument typography of procedure and function environment (by default the same as \AlCapNameSty{)}.

macros.name: SetProgSty
macros.doc: \SetProgSty{<font>} sets the KwProg typography to <font> (by default: emph).

macros.name: SetSideCommentLeft
macros.doc: \SetSideCommentLeft right justified side comments (side comments are flushed to the right), equivalent to scleft option.

macros.name: SetSideCommentRight
macros.doc: \SetSideCommentRight left justified side comments (side comments are put right after the code line) , equivalent to scright option.

macros.name: SetStartEndCondition
macros.doc: \SetStartEndCondition{typo1}{typo2}{typo3} which sets typo around condition in For, If, Switch, Case and Repeat macros.

macros.name: SetTitleSty
macros.doc: \SetTitleSty{type style}{type size} sets the typography and size of the titles defined with the macro \TitleOfAlgo{} (not with \caption).

macros.name: ShowLn
macros.doc: \ShowLn shows number of the line when linesnumberedhidden is activated.

macros.name: TitleOfAlgo
macros.doc: \TitleOfAlgo{thetitle} prints: “Algorithm n◦ : thetitle” in the typography and size defined by \SetTitleSty.

envs.name: algorithm
envs.doc: An algorithm is defined as a floating object like figures.
